items.text: In celebrating #BHM 2022, whose theme is ‘Black Health & Wellness,’ we recognize the work of Black health care workers in confronting the COVID-19 pandemic & the racial disparities that it has laid bare; we must ensure all communities have equitable access to medical resources.
This afternoon, I tested positive for COVID-19, and I am experiencing mild symptoms. Read my full statement: https://t.co/ef9mMRZ8hc

This year’s #BHM theme is Black Health and Wellness, and I am so glad that my friend @RepUnderwood is joining us at the #BHMBreakfast41 to bring awareness to the importance of this topic in our communities. Register today: https://t.co/syCOVXVaFy https://t.co/ZxYvkw418R

I am so thrilled to join friends, leaders, and #MD05 residents this morning at the #BHMBreakfast41! You can still RSVP to hear from our keynote speaker, Dr. Corbett, about Black health & wellness in our communities. https://t.co/syCOVXVaFy https://t.co/L4ObcRFDbU

At the annual #BHMBreakfast 41, we recognized the issue of health and wellness in the Black community. We must address the longstanding health disparities that continue to impact African Americans disproportionately and ensure that health equity for all is finally achieved. https://t.co/vjSoF50p1W

I spoke on the House Floor today in support of @VetAffairsDems' Honoring Our PACT Act to ensure that veterans exposed to toxic substances during their service have access to the medical treatment & benefits they have earned. I urge a yes vote. https://t.co/aNHTKAAw4E

Happy birthday to my friend @RepJahanaHayes from #CT05, who brings invaluable perspective as an educator to @EdLaborCmte & is a leader in the work to ensure students are properly fed as Chair of the Subcommittee on Nutrition, Oversight and Department Operations on @HouseAgDems.

This #NPHW, I join in thanking our frontline workers and those seeking to advance health equity and access to quality, affordable health care, which strengthens both our individual health and wellness as well as our communities as a whole. https://t.co/HEg9DQ5j8m

Tonight’s vote creating a pathway for Congressional staffers to unionize is an important step in ensuring the House is able to best serve Americans. Workers deserve the right to unionize and I am glad to see hardworking Congressional staff gain the ability to exercise that right.

I joined @SpeakerPelosi, @RosaDeLauro, @FrankPallone, @RepJahanaHayes and @SenStabenow today for a press conference on House Democrats’ work to address the infant formula shortage and ensure children have the nutrition they need to survive and thrive. https://t.co/DqbPL15aoO https://t.co/vgbqYJb0s5

I was proud to bring to the Floor the bipartisan #RestoringHope for Mental Health and Well-Being Act from @EnergyCommerce to strengthen more than 30 programs that support mental health care and substance abuse disorder treatment. https://t.co/2VspSPReWr

I thank @POTUS for hosting the first White House Conference on Hunger, Nutrition, and Health in more than 50 years and commend his new strategy to fight hunger and ensure Americans have access to the healthy food they need to learn, grow, and succeed. https://t.co/WdDCT6ACu9

.@RepRaskin is a dear friend of mine & partner in Congress. He’s a fighter for Marylanders & our Democracy, and I know he will be just as forceful in fighting his diagnosis as well. I wish him a fast recovery & stand by him and his family during this time. https://t.co/pFX8JgSSnr

Today, Republicans advanced legislation that seeks to denigrate & obstruct women who exercise their right to make their own health decisions. They also go against the will of the American people, an overwhelming majority of whom support a woman's right to reproductive autonomy.

59 years ago, the Food Stamp Act was signed – momentous legislation that strengthened the agricultural economy, improved nutrition in low-income households, & gave families peace of mind.

House Dems remain committed to protecting SNAP in the upcoming Farm Bill. https://t.co/4IiXYSlo9O

This legislation slashes funding for the Federal Public Defender program, which helps ensure every American can exercise their constitutional right to an attorney.

Why do my Republican colleagues refuse to uphold this critical constitutional right?

It was an honor to speak at the @EpilepsyFdn Congressional Caucus briefing.

My late wife Judy had epilepsy, so I know the challenges the diagnosis can pose. I also saw how much one can accomplish.

A disability doesn't stop someone from contributing to their community. https://t.co/7Tv7Mspal4

The @USDA's Summer Electronic Benefits Transfer will tackle child hunger when schools are out for the summer.

I'm proud Maryland is among the first to confirm their plans to implement Summer EBT in 2024—helping children in Maryland get the nutrition they need to grow and thrive.

I was proud to visit @AlpasLaPlata's behavioral health center.

Together, we are strengthening collaboration between government and mental health care providers to ensure that Maryland veterans and the most vulnerable in our region get the care they need.
https://t.co/DQBtHg0jqI https://t.co/Zt70Eou3dG

The Biden Admin is expanding health care coverage to DACA recipients – helping more than 100K people gain health insurance.

Dreamers are extraordinary young people who ought to have access to affordable health care just like all of us. This is their home – one nation, under God.

#TeamMaryland announced over $16M to bolster addiction treatment resources & support efforts to tackle illicit drugs in our state.

This @ONDCP funding will protect our communities, get dangerous drugs off our streets, & get people the support they need. https://t.co/155Ls4ri0j

May is #SkinCancerAwarenessMonth. 

Skin cancer is the most common cancer diagnosis in the U.S. – it is also the most preventable.

Be sure to use hats, sunscreen, sunglasses, and other protection to keep yourself safe this summer and all year-round.

I was proud to bring the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act to the Floor.

As John said, “Too many people struggled, suffered, & died to make it possible for every American to exercise their right to vote.”

Republicans ought to help us to do right by John & pass it. https://t.co/kY01rBeaUq

59 years ago, @MedicareGov and @MedicaidGov were signed into law, providing coverage for millions of families, seniors, and people with disabilities to get the care they need. 
 
Democrats are committed to strengthening coverage and lowering costs. https://t.co/2h3yoTGg7J

Great news: Medicare Open Enrollment begins today. From now until Dec. 7th, enrollees can explore new plans & benefits for 2025.

Visit https://t.co/i06PTH82L6 or call 1-800-MEDICARE to see if you are eligible for lower costs and better coverage.
